common_scorecard._block_note: v1.2: definitions for calibration..event_concentration are Conductor defaults (ruling 2026-09-24 ~19:34 ET). All values null (calibration may be 'N/A' when strategy emits no probabilities), measured=false, until measured on a frozen packet. Keys retained from v1 for continuity; ruling_label gives the ruling's name. Every default may be overridden only by a pre-outcome freeze declaration.

net_pnl_without_rewards.definition: p15 'Separate the profit sources': "Report trading P&L excluding rewards, exchange rewards actually earned, fees, inventory liquidation or settlement, and capital cost." p15 'Binary expected value': "expected net value per contract is q - p - net fees - other costs" (q conditional on info AND on our order filling); "Exit-based strategies must model realized entry and exit cash flows instead of replacing them with terminal payoff."
net_pnl_without_rewards.definition_status: partial_from_pdf (components named; no realized-P&L formula given)
net_pnl_without_rewards.feebook_formula_id_rule: fee-honest claims require the standing R1-P1 feebook formula_id pin
net_pnl_without_rewards.fee_components_source_note: p15 'Fees must be versioned': "Prefer actual recorded fee components."; "The repo's older cent-ceiling convention requires a version-and-account reconciliation, not an assumption that one formula covers every historical and current trade."
net_pnl_without_rewards.override_rule: freeze may override only if declared pre-outcome
net_pnl_without_rewards.keep_rule: KEEP judged on without-rewards net P&L unless the packet freeze explicitly declares the rewards thesis (card 03 only). p15 rule is law: "Do not hide a negative forecasting strategy inside a positive subsidy."

net_pnl_with_rewards.definition: p15/p16: "net P&L with and without rewards"; rewards component = "exchange rewards actually earned" (not an ideal estimate). p15: "Do not hide a negative forecasting strategy inside a positive subsidy."
net_pnl_with_rewards.definition_status: partial_from_pdf (no explicit formula; composition = net_pnl_without_rewards + rewards_actually_earned is NOT asserted here)
net_pnl_with_rewards.feebook_formula_id_rule: fee-honest claims require the standing R1-P1 feebook formula_id pin
net_pnl_with_rewards.override_rule: freeze may override only if declared pre-outcome
net_pnl_with_rewards.keep_basis_exception: Only if the packet freeze explicitly declares the rewards thesis pre-outcome, and only for card 03 (selective liquidity rewards). Even then without-rewards is still reported side by side.

rewards_actually_earned.definition: p15: "exchange rewards actually earned" ... "do not count an ideal reward estimate as cash received."
rewards_actually_earned.definition_status: partial_from_pdf (cash received, not estimate; no computation method given)
rewards_actually_earned.override_rule: freeze may override only if declared pre-outcome
rewards_actually_earned.v1_1_change: none (ruling: stays as in v1 - cash received only, never ideal estimate)

calibration.definition: Brier score + 10-bin reliability table (forecast probability vs settled outcome). Applies only when the strategy emits probabilities; otherwise value is "N/A" (not null).
calibration.unit: Brier score (dimensionless) + reliability table (10 bins: mean forecast probability vs observed settled frequency, count per bin)

reliability_table.bin_edges_note: 10 equal-width bins on [0,1]: bins 1-9 are [lower, upper), and the last bin is [0.9,1.0] closed.
reliability_table.thin_rule: flag a bin as thin when its count n<10

calibration.formula: Brier = mean over settled forecasts of (forecast_prob - settled_outcome)^2, outcome in {0,1} (standard Brier definition as named by ruling)
calibration.override_rule: freeze may override only if declared pre-outcome
calibration.definition_source: Conductor ruling 2026-09-24 ~19:34 ET (v1 RATIFIED plus defaults)

fill_rate.definition: Filled contracts / requested contracts at order level. Only fills tagged demo, shadow, or live count. Replay/simulated fills reported separately (simulated_fills section), labeled "simulated", never count toward KEEP.
fill_rate.formula: sum(filled_contracts) / sum(requested_contracts), order level, eligible fill tags only
fill_rate.override_rule: freeze may override only if declared pre-outcome
fill_rate.definition_source: Conductor ruling 2026-09-24 ~19:34 ET (v1 RATIFIED plus defaults)

adverse_selection_after_fills.definition: Signed mid move against our side at +60s, +300s, and settlement, cents per contract.
adverse_selection_after_fills.sign_convention: positive = the mid moved against our side (a cost to us); side = -1 for a buy and +1 for a sell.
adverse_selection_after_fills.formula: (mid_t - fill_price) * side, side = -1 for a buy and +1 for a sell; cents per contract; evaluate at +60s, +300s, and settlement.
adverse_selection_after_fills.override_rule: freeze may override only if declared pre-outcome
adverse_selection_after_fills.definition_source: Conductor ruling 2026-09-24 ~19:34 ET (v1 RATIFIED plus defaults)
worked_checks: buy at 50, mid 40: (40 - 50) * -1 = +10 cents per contract
sell at 50, mid 60: (60 - 50) * +1 = +10 cents per contract

feasible_vs_requested_size.definition: Fraction of requested size that visible depth supported at decision time, from the book at receipt time.
feasible_vs_requested_size.override_rule: freeze may override only if declared pre-outcome
feasible_vs_requested_size.definition_source: Conductor ruling 2026-09-24 ~19:34 ET (v1 RATIFIED plus defaults)

unresolved_inventory.definition: Open contracts and dollar risk at window end, marked at conservative (bid-side) value.
unresolved_inventory.override_rule: freeze may override only if declared pre-outcome
unresolved_inventory.definition_source: Conductor ruling 2026-09-24 ~19:34 ET (v1 RATIFIED plus defaults)

capital_hours.definition: Sum over positions of (max collateral at risk x hours held).
capital_hours.override_rule: freeze may override only if declared pre-outcome
capital_hours.definition_source: Conductor ruling 2026-09-24 ~19:34 ET (v1 RATIFIED plus defaults)

drawdown.definition: Max peak-to-trough on cumulative net P&L WITHOUT rewards.
drawdown.formula: max over t of ( max_{s<=t} cumPnL_wo_rewards(s) - cumPnL_wo_rewards(t) )
drawdown.dependency_note: Depends on net_pnl_without_rewards, which stays null until the Archivist fee/account-version manifest lands.
drawdown.override_rule: freeze may override only if declared pre-outcome
drawdown.definition_source: Conductor ruling 2026-09-24 ~19:34 ET (v1 RATIFIED plus defaults)

event_concentration.definition: Top-1 event share of positive net P&L, plus HHI over events; flag if top-1 share > 50%.
event_concentration.hhi_note: HHI is computed on each event share of absolute net P&L without rewards, on a 0-1 scale; top-1 event share of positive net P&L remains a separate flag (>50%).
event_concentration.dependency_note: P&L-based; depends on net P&L (null until Archivist manifest lands).
event_concentration.override_rule: freeze may override only if declared pre-outcome
event_concentration.definition_source: Conductor ruling 2026-09-24 ~19:34 ET (v1 RATIFIED plus defaults)
event_concentration.hhi_formula: sum over events e of (abs(net_pnl_without_rewards_e) / sum_j abs(net_pnl_without_rewards_j))^2

rewards_rule.side_by_side: Without-rewards and with-rewards net P&L always reported side by side.
rewards_rule.rewards_thesis_exception: Only if the packet freeze explicitly declares the rewards thesis (card 03 only).
rewards_rule.p15_quote: Do not hide a negative forecasting strategy inside a positive subsidy. Likewise, do not count an ideal reward estimate as cash received.
rewards_rule.rewards_actually_earned: unchanged from v1: cash received only, never ideal estimate

simulated_fills.label: simulated

fill_rate_simulated.label: simulated

simulated_fills.fill_model_ref_note: Fill model must be frozen in the preregistration (p16 item 'fill model').

stress_sensitivity._block_note: Adopted from proposed_optional (p16 'sensitivity to worse queues, latency and costs'). Scenarios per ruling: worse by one tick; 2x fees. Both P&L columns reported side by side.
stress_sensitivity.override_rule: freeze may override only if declared pre-outcome

one_tick_worse.definition: every fill price worse by one tick against our side (cost/queue/latency stress)
one_tick_worse.override_rule: freeze may override only if declared pre-outcome

fees_2x.override_rule: freeze may override only if declared pre-outcome

stress_sensitivity.dependency_note: P&L-based; null until Archivist fee/account-version manifest lands.

executable_dollars_per_day.definition: For each signal, executable contracts are min(requested size, visible depth at our limit price or better in the book at receipt time). Multiply by per-contract edge net of fees, where edge = expected value - price paid. Sum by calendar day in ET.
executable_dollars_per_day.formula: sum over signals per ET calendar day of min(requested_size, visible_depth_at_our_limit_price_or_better_at_receipt) * (expected_value - price_paid - fees_per_contract)
executable_dollars_per_day.override_rule: freeze may override only if declared pre-outcome

preregistration_checklist.source_quote_p16: Freeze the market universe, exclusions, receipt-time information set, fee regime, order timing, sizing, fill model, stopping rules and evaluation metrics before the test. common_scorecard_rules: All common_scorecard values are null and measured=false until measured on a frozen packet with artifacts.
Never back-fill any common_scorecard or control field from scout N, unit-test counts, fixtures, admit flags, or estimates.

v1.2: calibration, adverse selection, event concentration, and executable_dollars_per_day use the ratified defaults above. The net P&L formula remains pending_definition and must not be given an Examiner-invented formula.
net_pnl_with_rewards and net_pnl_without_rewards are always reported side by side; neither is omitted when the other is reported.

Rewards-inclusive P&L never substitutes for without-rewards P&L in a KEEP decision unless the packet freeze explicitly declares the rewards thesis pre-outcome, and only for card 03. The p15 rule is law (Conductor 2026-09-24). Both remain reported side by side.
rewards_actually_earned counts only rewards actually earned/received; ideal/estimated rewards are inadmissible (p15).

Fee-honest P&L claims require feebook formula_id astra.r1p1.feebook.claude_order_level_ceil.v1 (standing R1-P1 pin) and, once filed, a pinned Archivist fee/account-version manifest; until the manifest is filed, its reference stays null/pending and no manifest contents or formula ids are assumed.
Controls (market_only, simple_model, no_trade) are per packet; applies/result stay null (not applicable) until the packet freeze declares them.
Template revision only: adding fields here does not re-score, re-open, or alter any existing stamped verdict.
Default override policy: a packet freeze may override any default ONLY by declaring it before outcomes are seen; otherwise defaults apply. Post-outcome overrides are inadmissible.
calibration value is "N/A" (not null) when the strategy emits no probabilities; otherwise null until measured.
fill_rate counts only fills tagged demo, shadow or live. Replay/simulated fills go to simulated_fills, labeled "simulated", and never count toward KEEP.

Net P&L (both columns), drawdown, event_concentration and stress_sensitivity P&L stay null until the Archivist fee/account-version manifest lands and is pinned; a manifest landing does not by itself populate values.
preregistration_checklist is a REQUIRED gate for new cards 01-04; all items must be satisfied pre-test before any scoring.
study_label must be one of the five canonical PDF p16 classes; Archivist should adopt these names.

v1.2 resolved defaults: calibration bins are equal-width with prescribed edges and thin flag; adverse-selection sign is positive against our side with the stated formula; HHI uses absolute net P&L without rewards on a 0-1 scale; executable $/day uses receipt-time visible depth and ET median/p10 reporting.
